visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins in a darkened room where a male character with dark, styled hair is seen in silhouette, crouching beside a compact, cube-shaped silver projector. The projector emits a bright blue light onto a wall, displaying a high-contrast urban cityscape scene. Yellow text overlays appear on the left while the projector sits on a dark floor. (2) The scene transitions to a bright studio setting with a clean, light-colored background. The main character, wearing a black pinstriped blazer over a black shirt, holds the metallic silver LG CineBeam S projector toward the camera. His expression is enthusiastic, gesturing with his free hand while speaking directly to the lens. (3) Close-up shots of the projector follow, showcasing its sleek, dark-ribbed side panels and top-mounted lens. A hand is seen adjusting the device on a white rotating base. Overlays in white and bold font highlight technical specifications like 4K resolution and ultra-short throw distances against a neutral indoor background. (4) A demonstration of the projector's auto-focus and color correction features is shown. The character stands in front of a projection of a rainy street, his shadow cast upon it. Graphics illustrate the "8.1cm" distance. The lighting alternates between bright studio light and the colorful glow from the projected images. (5) The final phase shows the man holding the device again, looking into the camera. A screenshot of a crowdfunding page on the website "Zezze" is shown with product pricing and campaign progress. The character points toward the bottom of the screen, encouraging viewers to take action as the brand logo appears.
